description: Main-character progression model. Capability never rises for free; the engine debits a cost track for every credit on a capability track.

insight.label: Actuarial reading of systems and people

endurance.label: What the body and nerve absorb

connection.label: Capacity to be reached by another person

restraint.label: What he still refuses to do

anonymity.label: How unknown he remains to powers that matter

lie_grip.label: How firmly 'attachment is a policy' still holds

exchange_rules: Any +1 on a capability track requires -1 on at least one cost track, chosen on the page.
restraint falls whenever he does something he would previously have refused. It never rises.
connection may rise, but only from an act of another person's choosing, never his own effort.
lie_grip may only fall after an on-page failure of the lie to protect him. Never from reflection.
self_knowledge = 10 - lie_grip, enforced by the validator.
A capability track may not exceed its start value plus (chapter_number / 34) before Movement IV.

gates.name: The first taking
gates.on_page: Something dies near him and he chooses to take it. The choice is the scene.

gates.name: Registered as a person
gates.on_page: Vaurun issues him an identity he did not want.

gates.name: The first community
gates.on_page: He takes from a population rather than a person, and the count stops being countable by name.

gates.name: Someone stays
gates.on_page: A person is kind to him with nothing to gain, and he cannot process it. This is the novel's hinge and he fails it.

gates.name: Named by the Wardens
gates.on_page: The Verge Wardens identify what he is. Correctly. Too late.

gates.name: The last refusal spent
gates.on_page: The last thing he said he would not do, done. No coercion, no accident.

gates.name: Vaurun
gates.on_page: The act itself. It takes chapters, not a moment, and the count is given exactly (LK-COUNT-STANDS).

gates.name: The feeling does not arrive
gates.on_page: He finishes and waits for relief. Nothing comes. This is the break point, and it is quiet.

gates.name: What is left
gates.on_page: Not forgiveness and not peace-as-reward (LK-NO-ABSOLUTION). He goes on living, and goes.

development_spine.want: To make existence pay what it owes him.
development_spine.need: To be wanted by someone who gains nothing by it.
development_spine.lie: Every attachment is a policy someone has taken out on you.
development_spine.truth: Nothing owed him anything. That is the condition of being alive, not a cruelty.
development_spine.ghost: Abandoned at nine, robbed at thirty-three, killed at thirty-eight for GBP 1.4 million.
development_spine.arc_shape: tragic fall, then a survival he did not plan for
development_spine.final_state: Alive, leaving, carrying the exact count. Not absolved and not pretending to be.
